video_title: Stephen A. DOESN’T BELIEVE Draymond Green’s comments were disrespectful?! 👀 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike defends Jalen Brunson against Draymond Green's criticism
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the prince that was promised.
quotes.quote: I have a bigger issue with Draymond Green's comments on Jalen Brunson. We know the East is a relatively weaker conference, but I don't like his tone because it's not what you do, it's how you do it. You can only play the opponent that's right in front of you. The New York Knicks swept two series. Yes, it is a relatively weaker conference, but how they handled going through that, they manhandled their opponents. To me, that is more impressive. And now getting to Jalen Brunson, I don't know if you guys watch Game of Thrones, Jalen Brunson is the prince that was promised.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues against comparing Eastern and Western Conference competition
quotes.excerpt: So we can stop with the comparing of the conferences. It's competition out there.
quotes.quote: Brunson nonsense from Draymond Green, I'm going to just keep it a buck. Didn't last year an Eastern Conference team in the Indiana Pacers take the Oklahoma City Thunder to seven games? One could argue that if their best player in Tyrese Haliburton didn't get hurt, it looked like the momentum was swinging more for Indiana to win that game before he went out with that tear in his Achilles. Then this Western Conference, Anthony Edwards was banged up, both legs, no Luka Doncic. So we can stop with the comparing of the conferences. It's competition out there, right? The Knicks handled their business.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins defends Jalen Brunson's status as a top-tier player
quotes.excerpt: Right now, he's proving he's a proven 1A.
quotes.quote: I'm so tired of people disrespecting Jalen Brunson and what he's doing right now. Right now, he's proving he's a proven 1A. Whether he completes the mission or not, getting to the promised land is enough to prove that you're a 1A scorer in this league in the history of the game. We're never going to sit up here and say Allen Iverson wasn't a 1A option, and he got his Philadelphia 76ers team to the promised land but didn't complete the mission. We're not going to sit up here and say Charles Barkley wasn't a 1A when he had to face Jordan when he was with the Phoenix Suns.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith explains his support for Becky Hammon's coaching
quotes.excerpt: I'm taking this comments as backing up the great Becky Hammon.
quotes.quote: I agree with most of what both y'all said, especially his comments about the Eastern Conference because there was a lot of stuff that happened in the West with injuries where the road to prosperity wasn't as difficult as one might have thought. Houston didn't have a point guard, Luka Doncic didn't play, Anthony Edwards was hobbled, Dante Exum was out. There's a plethora of things that transpired that assisted in Oklahoma City and San Antonio being where they were. So I don't agree with him about the East, but what I will say to you is this: I'm not taking this comments as being disrespectful to Jalen Brunson to the degree that y'all are. I'm taking this comments as backing up the great Becky Hammon.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith advocates for Becky Hammon as an NBA head coach
quotes.excerpt: If men can coach in the WNBA, a woman should be coaching in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I've often said this statement: If men can coach in the WNBA, a woman should be coaching in the NBA as a head coach. And if a woman was in position to get a head coaching job, my first choice would be Becky Hammon, who I believe is a phenomenal coach. Three championships in five years in Vegas, Summer League championship coaching the men for San Antonio before she got the WNBA job. The woman is a spectacular coach and she knows her damn basketball. And so when she speaks, we should listen.

quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith and Chiney Ogwumike debate the importance of star teammates

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: Steph did have one of the top five shooters in the history of basketball as his backcourt mate in Clay Thompson. LeBron James had Matthew Dellavedova.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Which is why we should be praising Jalen Brunson, because he don't have that.
